fixes.explanation: I wish that were the case, friend, but the verse says the opposite. Isaiah says, "Among all the sons she brought up, there is no one to take her hand." Not one of them is named as stepping in to help her. So this one is False.

That's it, baker. "Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street, like an antelope in a net." Fainted is the word the verse uses. The antelope in a net is the picture Isaiah chooses, and it sticks. So "They have fainted" is just right.
